story.iWant: to manage my basic profile information
story.soThat: my account details are accurate and my data is protected
story.tasks: - [x] **Task 1: Implement Profile Settings UI (AC: All)** - [x] Create a UI page/component for "Profile Settings" accessible after login. - [x] Display user's basic profile information (name, email). - [x] Implement input fields and forms for updating profile information. - [x] Display link to privacy policy. - [x] **Task 2: Implement Profile Management API Endpoints (AC: All)** - [x] Create API routes for: - `GET /api/profile` (Retrieve user profile) - `PUT /api/profile` (Update user profile) - [x] Integrate with Supabase client to fetch and update user data (eg., from `users` table). - [x] Ensure API endpoints respect RLS policies. - [x] **Task 3: Implement Supabase RLS Policies (AC: All)** - [x] Define and implement RLS policies on the `users` table to ensure users can only access/modify their own data. - [x] Implement automated tests for RLS policies. - [x] **Task 4: Testing (AC: All)** - [x] Write unit tests for UI components and client-side validation. - [x] Write integration tests for profile API endpoints (retrieve, update). - [x] Write RLS integration tests to verify data isolation. - [x] Write end-to-end tests for the full profile management flow (dependent on registration and login). - [x] Manual testing of UI/UX, profile updates, and RLS behavior.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. **Given** I am logged in, **when** I navigate to my profile settings, **then** I can view and update basic profile information (e.g., name, email - if allowed by Supabase Auth). 2. **And** all my data (including profile) is protected by Row Level Security (RLS). 3. **And** a clear privacy policy is accessible from my profile. 4. **And** automated tests are in place to verify that RLS policies prevent one user from accessing another user's data.

constraint.description: Row Level Security (RLS) must be defined and implemented on the `users` table to ensure users can only access/modify their own data.
Adherence to data privacy regulations (FR1.2) for all user profile data.

tests.standards: The project uses Jest for unit and integration testing with coverage reporting. Different levels of testing are expected: unit for UI/client-side logic, integration for API endpoints, RLS integration tests for data isolation, and end-to-end for full user flows. Manual testing for UI/UX is also part of the standard.

idea.description: Verify user can view and update their profile information through the UI and API.
Verify RLS policies effectively prevent unauthorized users from accessing or modifying profile data.
Verify the privacy policy is accessible from the profile settings UI.
Automated tests specifically for RLS policies are in place and pass.
